decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Variation of condition 26 (public art)  to read:
'Details of the proposed two features of public art as shown on the submitted drawings including details of location, size and appearance shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA before the development commences on each relevant phase. The piece of public art on Ferry wharf shall be installed before the last occupation (definition as per the section 106 agreement) of phase 1(definition as per the section 106 agreement) of the scheme and the piece of public art adjoining Soaphouse Creek shall be installed before the last occupation of phase 3 (definition as per phase 3 of the section 106 agreement) of the development '
description: Following approval for demolition of existing and redevelopment of site for mixed commercial/residential use part details submitted pursuant to Condition 26 (public art) - variation of wording  of approved permission reference number 00443/G/P3 dated 06/07/1999.
